questions.stem: DevOps is a set of practices that combines which two things?
questions.explanation: DevOps combines software development (Dev) with IT Operations (Ops) into one set of practices.

questions.stem: DevOps is described as "a physical face of Agile". What does DevOps mostly operationalise?
questions.explanation: DevOps is mostly about operationalising Agile processes, which is why it is called the physical face of Agile.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT listed among the activities DevOps includes?
questions.explanation: DevOps includes Plan, Create, Verify, Package, Release, Configure, Monitor and Version Control; Data Wrangling is not among them.

questions.stem: Under what condition can engineers in DevOps independently accomplish tasks such as deploying code or provisioning infrastructure?
options: Only when a separate operations team approves each step
Only if most activities, from provisioning resources to testing and deployment, are automated
Only when working in a Waterfall project
Only if security is handled by a different department
Only when the team is smaller than five people
questions.explanation: Engineers can run their own end-to-end show only if most activities, such as provisioning VMs and compute, testing, integration testing and deployment, are automated.

questions.stem: Which framework automates the DevOps activities such as provisioning, testing, integration testing and deployment?
options: CI/CD, Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery/Deployment
questions.explanation: The automation is provided by CI/CD, which stands for Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery or Deployment.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT one of the DevOps key elements?
questions.explanation: The key elements are Automation, Small Changes, Regular Enhancement/Fixes and Teamwork; large infrequent releases run counter to DevOps.

questions.stem: Which sequence describes the DevOps process flow?
options: Regular Development, Regular Build, Regular Testing, Regular Deployment, Regular Run
questions.explanation: The DevOps process flow is Regular Development, Regular Build, Regular Testing, Regular Deployment and Regular Run.

questions.stem: According to the quotes attributed to Synopsys, what does DevOps focus on?
options: Culture, highlighting roles that emphasise responsiveness
Processes, highlighting change while accelerating delivery
Software-defined life cycles, highlighting tools that emphasise automation
questions.explanation: The quote says DevOps focuses on culture, highlighting roles that emphasise responsiveness.

questions.stem: According to the same set of quotes, what does CI/CD focus on?
options: Software-defined life cycles, highlighting tools that emphasise automation
questions.explanation: CI/CD focuses on software-defined life cycles, highlighting tools that emphasise automation.

questions.stem: How is Agile characterised in contrast with DevOps and CI/CD?
options: Agile focuses on tools that emphasise automation
Agile focuses on roles that emphasise responsiveness
Agile focuses on processes, highlighting change while accelerating delivery
questions.explanation: Agile focuses on processes highlighting change while accelerating delivery, whereas CI/CD emphasises tools and DevOps emphasises culture.
